about.heroSubtitle: Discover the story behind one of the most prestigious residences in the city, where luxury meets comfort and every detail is crafted for excellence.
about.storyP1: Founded with a vision to create more than just a place to stay, DarElKhair was designed to be a home away from home. Each apartment blends careful architectural craftsmanship with constant attention to our guests' wellbeing.
about.storyP2: Our name draws inspiration from ancient traditions, evoking generosity and hospitality. That spirit guides everything we do, to deliver memorable stays in the heart of Nouakchott.
about.missionBody: To provide exceptional accommodation experiences that exceed expectations, creating memorable stays for every guest through personalized service, luxurious amenities, and unwavering attention to detail.
about.visionBody: To be the leading destination for luxury accommodation, setting new standards in hospitality excellence.
about.valuesSubtitle: The principles that guide everything we do.
about.value1Body: A total commitment to service quality, at every step of your stay.
about.value2Body: Warm, welcoming environments where every guest feels at home.
about.value3Body: Continuous improvement to bring you ever more comfort and simplicity.
about.ctaSubtitle: Discover our apartments and book your next stay.

home.value1Body: An intuitive and secure system to book your stay in just minutes.
home.value2Body: Pay by bank transfer, mobile money, or cash, with proof verified by our team.
home.value3Body: Apartments ideally located in the heart of the city, close to everything.
home.howSubtitle: Book your next stay in three simple steps.
home.step1Body: Explore our apartments and find the one that fits you.
home.step2Body: Pick your dates, check availability, and confirm your booking.
home.step3Body: Confirm your payment and enjoy your stay to the fullest.
home.testimonial1Quote: An exceptional experience! The apartment was perfect and the service flawless.
home.testimonial2Quote: Simple and fast booking. The place matched the photos exactly.
home.testimonial3Quote: A very pleasant stay, I warmly recommend DarElKhair to everyone.
